shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---GIT---" && git -C /workspace log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || echo "no commits yet"
npm install express ejs && echo "INSTALLED OK"

rm -rf /workspace/data; PORT=3456 node src/server.js > /tmp/books-server.log 2>&1 &
echo "server pid $!"; sleep 1; cat /tmp/books-server.log

echo "== HOME (empty) ==" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/
echo "== ADD BOOK (follow redirect) ==" && curl -s -i -L -X POST http://localhost:3456/books \
  --data-urlencode "title=The Pragmatic Programmer" \
  --data-urlencode "author=Hunt & Thomas" \
  --data-urlencode "notes=Read chapter 1&2" \
  --data-urlencode "status=reading" | grep -Ei "^(HTTP|Location|status=|<title>|<h1>|book-title|notes-body)" | head -20
echo "== DATA FILE ==" && cat /workspace/data/books.json

echo "== files under src ==" ; ls -la /workspace/src/data 2>&1
echo "== files under workspace/data ==" ; ls -la /workspace/data 2>&1
echo "== home page body ==" ; curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -Eio "book-title|Pragmatic|empty|Currently reading|Finished" | head
echo "== direct detail GET ==" ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/books/9b4b5e12-45f7-4891-8a39-5b64dd8ee643

kill 704 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
rm -rf /workspace/src/data /workspace/data
echo "=== Start #1 ===" 
PORT=3456 node src/server.js > /tmp/books-server.log 2>&1 &
PID1=$!; sleep 1
echo "pid $PID1"; cat /tmp/books-server.log
echo "=== Add a book (status only) ==="
LOC=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" -X POST http://localhost:3456/books \
  --data-urlencode "title=Piranesi" --data-urlencode "author=Susanna Clarke" \
  --data-urlencode "notes=Loved the atmosphere" --data-urlencode "status=reading")
echo "redirect -> $LOC"
echo "=== Mark finished ==="
ID=$(basename "$LOC")
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish status=%{http_code}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3456/books/$ID/finish"
echo "=== Detail page ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:3456/books/$ID" | grep -Eio "Piranesi|Susanna Clarke|Loved the atmosphere|Finished|Currently reading|Share this book|localhost:3456/books/$ID" | sort -u
echo "=== data file path & contents ==="
ls -la /workspace/data/books.json
cat /workspace/data/books.json
echo "=== Kill server #1 ==="
kill $PID1; sleep 0.5
echo "=== Start #2 (restart, expect book to persist) ==="
PORT=3456 node src/server.js > /tmp/books-server2.log 2>&1 &
PID2=$!; sleep 1; cat /tmp/books-server2.log
curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -Eio "Piranesi|Susanna Clarke|finished .* 20[0-9]" | sort -u
kill $PID2
pkill -f "src/server.js" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/data; echo "cleaned"; jobs -l 2>/dev/null; echo "--- tests ---"; npm test 2>&1 | tail -8
rm -rf /workspace/data; pgrep -af "src/server.js" || echo "no server running"; echo "=== npm test ==="; npm test 2>&1 | tail -8
pgrep -af "node src/server" || echo "no node server running"
